releaseState: Local candidate qualified; product-contract, metadata, agent-index, footer, map-delivery, and performance changes are not deployed by this audit.

contentPurpose.evidence: Independent revised review scored product 25/25, audience 15/15, value 15/15, mechanism 15/15, proof 10/15, and next action 14/15. geo.evidence: Candidate source provides llms.txt, llms-full.txt, index.md, api/ai, robots, sitemap, OpenAPI, and JSON-LD with crawler access and Markdown coverage. Astro dev audit reached S-tier 100.
